title: dactylis lobata
intro: Dactylis lobata, commonly known as Orchard Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Europe and Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support respiratory health. The plant is also known for its therapeutic actions, such as its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, and its use as a diuretic to promote urinary function. The bioactive constituents of Dactylis lobata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
